segments.text: Remember when OpenClaw was called Moltbot and before that Claudebot? This repo has kept up through all the rebrands. It's basically the awesome
list for AI assistant skills. 700 plus community tools organized into 27 categories. Browser automation, DevOps,
health tracking, podcast management, everything. Every skill works with Claude code and other assistants that respect the standard.
